tools.name: caselaw_search
tools.description:
Full-text search of Pakistani judgments (Supreme Court, High Courts, Federal Shariat Court
    and tribunals, 1970 onward), with optional filters by court, judge, author, law report and year.

    Ranking follows how lawyers research: nearness to the legal point decides which cases are
    returned;

tools.name: caselaw_search_questions
tools.description:
Find judgments by the QUESTION they settle, rather than by words they contain.

tools.name: caselaw_lookup_citation
tools.description:
Find the judgment(s) at an exact law-report citation.

    Example: journal='PLD', year=1995, page=34  → PLD 1995 Supreme Court 34.
    Omit page to list everything reported in that journal+year. Returns the same case shape
    as caselaw_search.

tools.name: caselaw_get_case
tools.description:
Fetch one judgment by id.

    section='summary' (default) returns metadata + the headnote (plain-language summary, the
    laws/provisions referred, and keyword tags) — read this first to judge relevance cheaply.

tools.name: caselaw_get_citations
tools.description:
Walk the citation graph FORWARD: list the in-corpus cases that THIS judgment cites
    (the precedents it relied on). Combine with caselaw_get_cited_by to traverse precedent
    backward and forward until a research question is resolved.

tools.name: caselaw_get_cited_by
tools.description:
Walk the citation graph BACKWARD: list later cases that cite THIS judgment
    (how it was subsequently treated — followed, distinguished, relied upon). Returns newest first.

    Most useful on OLDER or landmark judgments: it shows whether the case is still followed and

tools.name: caselaw_most_cited
tools.description:
List the most-cited (landmark) judgments in the corpus, ranked by how many other cases
    cite them. A good entry point for the leading authorities on Pakistani law.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: caselaw_search · Private data: caselaw_search_questions · Public sink: caselaw_get_citations.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: caselaw_search · Private data: caselaw_search_questions · Public sink: caselaw_get_citations

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
